news.headline: Tyler Shough is back to full practice
news.summary: The Saints quarterback hurt his left hand in Sunday's loss to Minnesota, and on Wednesday he took part in the whole practice. Receiver Chris Olave stayed out sick, and linebacker Kaden Elliss sat out with a sore calf.

news.headline: Coach Moore says the owner speaks for everyone
news.summary: Owner Gayle Benson said this week that the Saints' 1-4 start is not acceptable, and coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that she speaks for the whole team. Quarterback Tyler Shough said the players expected that message and want to make her proud.

news.headline: The Saints' long snapper is practicing again
news.summary: Zach Wood practiced Wednesday for the first time since he hurt his calf. He is the long snapper who handles the ball on every punt and every field goal, and he can rejoin the team when he is ready to play.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff in Austin against Texas.

news.headline: Florida may be without its quarterback at Texas
news.summary: Aaron Philo hurt his shoulder in Saturday's loss to South Carolina, and he has done only part of practice this week. If he cannot play Saturday at Texas, Tramell Jones Jr. would start for the first time.

news.headline: Vernell Brown III is practicing again
news.summary: Florida's leading receiver has practiced all week after hurting his knee and missing the last two games. He has a real chance to play Saturday at Texas.

news.headline: Sumrall takes a bigger hand in the defense
news.summary: Jon Sumrall said Monday that he is working with the Florida defense more day to day after South Carolina scored 38 points in Gainesville. He said he is not taking the defense over from Brad White and still has a lot of confidence in that staff.

nextGame.note: Late morning home game in Baton Rouge. Mississippi State is 4-1.

news.headline: Mississippi State's quarterback is a maybe for Saturday
news.summary: The league's Wednesday injury list has quarterback Kamario Taylor and leading runner Fluff Bothwell both listed as questionable, with a toe injury and an ankle injury. LSU will again be without tight end Trey'Dez Green and linebacker Whit Weeks.

news.headline: LSU gets $500,000 from Kentucky
news.summary: Kentucky fans ran onto the field after beating LSU 35-34 on Saturday, which the league does not allow. The league fined Kentucky $500,000, and the rules send that money to LSU.

news.headline: LSU sends a touchdown play to the league office
news.summary: Coach Lane Kiffin said Monday he sent the tape of Kentucky's short fourth-down touchdown to the conference office and had not heard back. He also thought officials missed a block in the back on a 55-yard punt return, but said the calls even out over time.

nextGame.note: Friday night home game at Yulman Stadium. Memphis has won five of its six games. Tulane is calling it Light it Uptown: the first 1,500 fans get light-up glasses, and there is a drone show at halftime and during the game.

news.headline: Tulane has not named a quarterback for Friday
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that the job is open and that Tulane has to play better at quarterback. Three players have taken turns there this season.

news.headline: Tulane's last game is set for November 28
news.summary: The conference picked Saturday, November 28, for Tulane's trip to South Florida. The kickoff time and the TV channel will be announced about two weeks before the game.

news.headline: Army beats Tulane 20-17 on the last play
news.summary: Army kicked a field goal as time ran out at West Point on Saturday. Tulane had tied the game late on a 39-yard touchdown pass from Kadin Semonza to Jaylin Lucas, and hosts Memphis next Friday night.

nextGame.note: Thursday night road game in River Ridge, and a district game. John Curtis has won two games and lost four, and has lost three in a row.

news.headline: Easton Royal picks Florida over Texas
news.summary: The Brother Martin receiver had been committed to Texas since last November. He switched to Florida on Sunday, a day after a visit to the Florida campus.

news.headline: Brother Martin drops out of the state top 10
news.summary: Friday's loss to Rummel moved Brother Martin out of the Crescent City Sports top 10 for the biggest class. The Crusaders are 4-2 and play at John Curtis on Thursday.

news.headline: Rummel beats Brother Martin 33-10
news.summary: Brother Martin kicked a field goal to start Friday afternoon at Tad Gormley Stadium, then lost two fumbles and never caught up. It is a second loss in a row and Brother Martin is now 4-2.
